records.title: Deemed-to-be University to GKCIET
details:
a to c: after approval of its BOG, GKCIET, has submitted its application to the UGC for Deemed to be University under Distinct/De Novo Category.
UGC is a statutory body of the Ministry of Education, and processes the submitted applications for grant of Deemed to be University Status as per the procedure laid under the University Grants Commission (Institutions deemed to be Universities) Regulations, 2023.
